title: Overlay status feed messages
description: JSON status events the orchestrator broadcasts over a localhost-only socket for the Teleprompter overlay to render (spec/00 D13, Contract P). Transport is one JSON object per line (NDJSON) on 127.0.0.1. The overlay is a dumb subscriber: it renders whatever arrives and never drives the voice loop. Protocol: receivers ignore unknown message types (log once); every message carries 'type'. The 'state' values are the overlay's own; its listening indicator inherits spec/50's truthful-indicator rule (shows 'listening' only while audio is actually being captured).

state.description: orchestrator->overlay: coarse session state — drives the island's mode (idle = asleep/hidden, listening = bars, thinking = processing, speaking = reply shown, error = fault). 'listening' also covers the follow-up window (mic open, spec/40).

transcript.description: orchestrator->overlay: the user's transcribed prompt AFTER the deterministic word-replacement/cleanup (spec/40, D15). 'final':false is reserved for streaming STT (deferred); M0 always sends final:true. The overlay accumulates finals for the expandable session history (D14, in-memory).

response.description: orchestrator->overlay: one chunk of the brain's reply as it streams (the teleprompter, D14). The overlay appends 'delta' to the current reply; 'done':true marks the reply complete. A 'state' message resets the reply for the next turn.

mic.description: orchestrator->overlay: mic input level in [0,1], emitted while capturing — drives the listening bars and IS the spec/50 truthful-streaming indicator (present <=> audio is being captured). High-frequency and droppable; the overlay must not infer 'listening' from anything else.

latency.description: orchestrator->overlay: a per-turn latency reading as the orchestrator measures it against the spec/40 targets. 'feedback' = end-of-speech -> first perceptible feedback; 'first_word' = end-of-speech -> first spoken word. Instrument data for the M0 acceptance run, not user-facing chrome by default.
